description:
v1.0 | 191 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Adds 1 to a 64-bit number.

Use this to add one to a value in a creation, such as a score that counts up by one or a step counter in a computer's memory.

Feed it one binary number, lowest bit first. The output is the number plus one. The carry output is on only when every input bit was one.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the number = x 0-63.
Outputs (green gates): result = x 0-63, carry = x 64.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on about a million inputs in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits/tree/main/circuits/incrementer
